description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's multi-pack index (MIDX) features, including incremental updates, conversions, bundling, and verification procedures. It contains test cases that invoke Git commands to manipulate and verify multi-pack indexes, and uses various test utility functions.

methods.name: write_midx_layer
methods.description: A helper function that writes a new multi-pack index layer by committing changes and repacking, then creating an incremental index with bitmap.
